svg.title: $725,000 Contract Revenue to $87,000 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-revenue-to-owner-net; chart type: waterfall; title: $725,000 Contract Revenue to $87,000 Owner Net; subtitle: Six bars reconcile the Base-Case annual operating result to a 12.0% net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: USD per year. The first and last bars are absolute totals; the four middle bars are negative movements. Intermediate balances are $290,000, $246,500, $166,750, and $87,000. Cost categories are an illustrative allocation, not additional canonical scorecard inputs. Owner net is the operating residual before owner-specific income taxes.; caption: $725,000 minus $435,000 minus $43,500 minus $79,750 minus $79,750 equals $87,000. Costs total $638,000, or 88.0% of revenue; owner net equals 12.0%. The stated $4,000–$18,000 monthly opex range cannot serve as an all-in cost ceiling for this scenario; its coverage must be reconciled before bidding.; stages: label: Earned contract revenue; value: $725,000 annual cleaning service revenue; opening total; numeric value: 725000.0; detail: Use the canonical Base-Case gross revenue for completed cleaning services. Exclude sales taxes collected for remittance and customer business turnover.; label: Direct service labor; value: Subtract $435,000 for paid delivery labor and burden; numeric value: -435000.0; detail: Allocate 60.0% of revenue to field employee wages, employer payroll charges, field workers' compensation, paid travel, overtime, callbacks, and legitimate subcontract service invoices. Remaining balance: $290,000.; label: Supplies and equipment; value: Subtract $43,500 for chemicals, consumables, and equipment; numeric value: -43500.0; detail: Allocate 6.0% of revenue to cleaning chemicals, liners, microfiber replacement, equipment rental or depreciation, and repairs. Keep equipment purchase cash flows separate from annual expense recognition. Remaining balance: $246,500.; label: Supervision and operations; value: Subtract $79,750 for oversight and shared operating costs; numeric value: -79750.0; detail: Allocate 11.0% of revenue to supervisor compensation and burden, management work, vehicles, storage, general liability, and inspection systems. Assign each payroll hour once; exclude field labor already charged above. Remaining balance: $166,750.; label: Selling and administration; value: Subtract $79,750 for acquisition, billing, and administration; numeric value: -79750.0; detail: Allocate 11.0% of revenue to estimating, account sales, administrative compensation and burden, accounting, payment fees, bad-debt expense, and other operating expenses. Include compensation for owner work where applicable before calculating residual profit. Remaining balance: $87,000.; label: Annual owner net; value: $87,000 residual owner profit; closing total at 12.0%; numeric value: 87000.0; detail: Render this bar from zero, not as another positive movement. Preserve the other canonical scenarios: $250,000 at 8.0% yields $20,000; $1,200,000 at 16.0% yields $192,000.

rect.title: label: Earned contract revenue; value: $725,000 annual cleaning service revenue; opening total; numeric value: 725000.0; detail: Use the canonical Base-Case gross revenue for completed cleaning services. Exclude sales taxes collected for remittance and customer business turnover.

label: Direct service labor; value: Subtract $435,000 for paid delivery labor and burden; numeric value: -435000.0; detail: Allocate 60.0% of revenue to field employee wages, employer payroll charges, field workers' compensation, paid travel, overtime, callbacks, and legitimate subcontract service invoices. Remaining balance: $290,000.

label: Supplies and equipment; value: Subtract $43,500 for chemicals, consumables, and equipment; numeric value: -43500.0; detail: Allocate 6.0% of revenue to cleaning chemicals, liners, microfiber replacement, equipment rental or depreciation, and repairs. Keep equipment purchase cash flows separate from annual expense recognition. Remaining balance: $246,500.

label: Supervision and operations; value: Subtract $79,750 for oversight and shared operating costs; numeric value: -79750.0; detail: Allocate 11.0% of revenue to supervisor compensation and burden, management work, vehicles, storage, general liability, and inspection systems. Assign each payroll hour once; exclude field labor already charged above. Remaining balance: $166,750.

label: Selling and administration; value: Subtract $79,750 for acquisition, billing, and administration; numeric value: -79750.0; detail: Allocate 11.0% of revenue to estimating, account sales, administrative compensation and burden, accounting, payment fees, bad-debt expense, and other operating expenses. Include compensation for owner work where applicable before calculating residual profit. Remaining balance: $87,000.

label: Annual owner net; value: $87,000 residual owner profit; closing total at 12.0%; numeric value: 87000.0; detail: Render this bar from zero, not as another positive movement. Preserve the other canonical scenarios: $250,000 at 8.0% yields $20,000; $1,200,000 at 16.0% yields $192,000.
